owner_approval: All twelve November 20 AAR actions and broader non-news video resources explicitly approved in the current conversation.
scope: Eight additional non-news discovery routes with first-party creator or recorded-library evidence. Original item dates and playback remain unverified unless expressly listed.

qualifications.name: Computerphile AI explanations
qualifications.review_scope: Original verified Computerphile upload describes neural language and model reasoning. Some programs exceed 20 minutes; each candidate still needs duration and substantive review.

qualifications.name: 3Blue1Brown AI and neural network explanations
qualifications.review_scope: Original creator homepage identifies its current compression and language-model video, publication date and official channel. Date belongs to that example, not every lesson.

qualifications.name: StatQuest neural networks and AI
qualifications.review_scope: Original creator video index links its AI series; verified StatQuest RLHF upload has original date and chaptered substance. Older examples only establish source identity.

qualifications.name: AI Coffee Break research explanations
qualifications.review_scope: Original creator site explicitly offers research-paper and AI concept video explanations. It qualifies the public recorded-video library; no date or playback is inferred for a specific program.

qualifications.name: MIT CSAIL research video archive
qualifications.review_scope: MIT publishes a recorded symposium with individual original YouTube programs. June 27 2023 is the event date, not a new upload date. Use the original Videoarchive link for newer discovery.

qualifications.name: MIT Embodied Intelligence seminars
qualifications.review_scope: MIT explicitly links its official recorded seminar channel. This is a distinct discovery route in the same MIT original-publisher family, not an extra independent publisher.

qualifications.name: PyTorch Foundation technical talks and demonstrations
qualifications.review_scope: Official on-demand video library links maintainer Q and A and engineering talks with individual dates. Product promotion, full duration and playback require candidate review.

qualifications.name: Full Stack Deep Learning recorded LLM courses
qualifications.review_scope: Original public course library explicitly offers free April 2023 recordings. Course date is not program upload precision; old or long lectures cannot be selected without existing exceptions.

limitations: Older example programs are identity evidence and are not automatically eligible for a current edition.
MIT CSAIL and MIT Embodied Intelligence are one publisher family.
Some programs are too long for final selection. No duration, freshness, promotion, archive or signed-out playback requirement changes.
ACM and PyData attempts were inaccessible and were not added as qualified sources.
